data.name: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd
data.about: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd is engaged in the business of manufacturing, developing and marketing a wide range of branded and generic formulations and Active Pharma Ingredients (APIs). The company and its subsidiaries has various manufacturing facilities spread across the world with trading and other incidental and related activities extending to global market.[1]It is the largest pharmaceutical company in India.[2]

data.what_it_does: Sun Pharma is India's largest pharmaceutical company with an 8.4% market share, selling a comprehensive portfolio of pharmaceuticals, branded generics, generics, APIs, and consumer healthcare products across India and approximately 90 countries globally. Its business spans innovative medicines focused on dermatology, ophthalmology, and onco-dermatology, as well as a large generic and API business serving both domestic and international markets.

bull.text: The company delivered 3-year revenue and PAT CAGR of 10% and 10.6% respectively, with operating margin expanding from 26.5% to 28.2% and ROCE at 21%.
Balance sheet strength is evident with a low debt-to-equity of 0.06 and operating cash flow covering PAT 1.2x over the last three years.
Sun Pharma is India's largest pharmaceutical company with an 8.4% domestic market share and a diversified presence across approximately 90 countries.

bear.text: Quarterly PAT has declined sequentially from ₹3,381 Cr in Dec 2025 to ₹2,710 Cr in Mar 2026 and ₹2,901 Cr in Jun 2026 despite stable revenue.
The India business contributes 33% of revenue but management expects its share to fall to 17%, increasing geographic concentration risk.
Management acknowledges the established product business is currently stagnant and not growing, with only a hope for single-digit growth ahead.
